blocks.html: Short answer: Phetchaburi has both a coast and an old town. For the beach stay in Cha-am — a long, family-friendly beach that is calmer than Hua Hin, with resorts and seafront restaurants. For temples and history choose Phetchaburi town near Khao Wang (Phra Nakhon Khiri), old temples and the famous local desserts; for nature head to Kaeng Krachan with its forest park and reservoir.

faq.q: Where is the best beach stay in Phetchaburi?
faq.a: Cha-am is the main beach — long, gentle and family-friendly, with resorts and rooms for every budget and plenty of seafront seafood. It is relaxed and quieter than Hua Hin just to the south.

faq.q: How is Cha-am different from Hua Hin?
faq.a: Cha-am is a Thai family beach town — quieter and cheaper, with seafront seafood dining, while Hua Hin has more nightlife, malls and international restaurants. They are about 25 km apart and easy to combine.

faq.q: Where to stay for Khao Wang and old-town Phetchaburi?
faq.a: Stay in Phetchaburi town for Khao Wang (Phra Nakhon Khiri), Wat Mahathat, the Khao Luang cave and the local dessert shops. The old town is small and easy to see in a day, and many combine it with Cha-am or a trip further south.
